catalog.title: Gaia DR3 nearby stellar visualization subset

provenance.licenceId: Gaia DR3 open data with ESA/Gaia/DPAC credit
provenance.notes: Gaia DR3 data are open and free to use with ESA/Gaia/DPAC credit. This visualization-oriented subset includes optional Solar-system-barycentric radial velocity and the published within-source astrometric correlations; it is not a statistically complete volume sample.

query.text:
SELECT source_id, ref_epoch, ra, ra_error, dec, dec_error, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, radial_velocity, radial_velocity_error, ra_dec_corr, ra_parallax_corr, ra_pmra_corr, ra_pmdec_corr, dec_parallax_corr, dec_pmra_corr, dec_pmdec_corr, parallax_pmra_corr, parallax_pmdec_corr, pmra_pmdec_corr, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, teff_gspphot, ruwe
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE parallax >= 10
  AND parallax_over_error >= 10
  AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 9
  AND (astrometric_params_solved = 31 OR astrometric_params_solved = 95)
  AND duplicated_source = 'false'
query.interpretation: Distances are the naive inverse of positive Gaia parallax for rendering. The selection limits fractional parallax uncertainty but does not apply the Gaia parallax zero-point correction or a Bayesian distance prior.

exoplanetHostCrossmatch.navigationGuarantee: Every exact-match Gaia source is retained as a searchable navigation record, independent of the ordinary per-chunk brightness limit.
exoplanetHostCrossmatch.boundary: Only exact NASA Exoplanet Archive gaia_dr3_id values present in the receipted SpaceViewer Gaia subset are linked; no positional nearest-neighbour match is inferred.

spatialPartition.note: The all-sky bright core loads first; fainter sources are partitioned into 48 level-1 HEALPix cells encoded by Gaia source_id, then pending cells are reprioritized against the live camera direction.

derivedPosition.formula: distance_pc=1000/parallax_mas; ICRS spherical to heliocentric Cartesian; light_year=parsec*3.2615637771674333
derivedPosition.caveat: Distances are the naive inverse of positive Gaia parallax for rendering. The selection limits fractional parallax uncertainty but does not apply the Gaia parallax zero-point correction or a Bayesian distance prior.

propagation.uncertaintyTreatment: Selected Gaia navigation stars use the complete six-parameter uniform-rectilinear transform. Forward automatic differentiation evaluates all 36 Jacobian terms, and C=J*C0*J' propagates the ten Gaia within-source astrometric correlations plus independent published radial-velocity uncertainty into the angular confidence ellipse and 3D ICRS Cartesian position ellipsoid.
propagation.limitations: Missing radial velocities remain an explicit 0 km/s fallback with covariance conditional on that value because no undocumented velocity-dispersion prior is invented. The model omits light-time, non-single-star acceleration solutions, the parallax zero-point correction, Bayesian distance inference, and between-source correlations.

brightnessProxy.purpose: Display transfer for point size and alpha; the source G magnitude remains authoritative.
